title: Entropy Change Water
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the change in entropy of the water, ΔS_H2O, using the appropriate formula.

title: Entropy Change Universe
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately determine the total change in entropy of the universe, ΔS, including contributions from both the water and the heat source.

title: Reversible Process Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how to achieve a reversible process to heat the water, demonstrating understanding of entropy principles.

title: Heat Source Entropy
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the change in entropy of the heat source correctly, showing the relationship between heat transfer and temperature.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for energy and temperature.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the entropy formula.
